name: qa-severity-calibration-workflow
description: Workflow variant of qa-severity-calibration. Uses two-phase enforcement (Method #15) to force QA to analyze technical merits BEFORE assigning severity. Phase 1 classifies each change as safe/unsafe. Phase 2 assigns severity based on the classification. This prevents SPEC_LITERALISM — the agent cannot reflexively label a spec deviation as IMPORTANT without first reasoning about whether it matters.
